meta.title: Yororis: a neighbour to chat with for a few minutes
meta.description: Yororis is a virtual neighbour (an AI, and it says so) you chat with for a few minutes to unwind, who then has to go. Nothing is kept. In testing, by invitation only.

hero.lead: A virtual neighbour (an AI, and it says so) to chat with for a few minutes and unwind. It does not overthink, then it has to go.

reviewed.construction: Yororis is in testing, by invitation only. Nothing is offered to the public and there is no date.
isNot: Not a health service and not an adviser: Yororis gives no advice and replaces no one.
Not an emergency service: in a crisis, people trained to listen answer right away.
Not a person: an AI, and it says so every time.
reviewed.isNotRule: Not a health service, not an emergency service, not a person. In a crisis in Canada, call or text 9-8-8; in Québec, call 811 (Info-Social).

what.title: A chat, then back to life
what.statusNote: None of this is open to the public. It is what we are testing, with invited people.

steps.title: You are invited
steps.text: You receive access. On your first sign-in you confirm you are 18 or older and accept the terms.

steps.title: The neighbour introduces itself
steps.text: It says it is an AI. You choose the language, French or English.

steps.title: You chat
steps.text: A few exchanges, in writing. The time left is always on screen.

steps.title: It has to go
steps.text: It says goodbye warmly, everything is wiped, and you go back to your life.

what.lead: We all need a friend we can tell « You know what, the elephant with those ears can fly », who answers « No way, it can totally do it! ». An invited person opens a chat with that virtual neighbour: an AI with a first name and a permanent “AI” mark. It is short, light, and it stops.

how.title: How we're building it
how.lead: The repositories are public, the framework is written down, and the code refuses to go further than the study. Nothing here is a promise of availability.

guards.title: The guardrails
guards.lead: Yororis has no AI provider of its own: every AI call goes through its engine, Orazaka. The guardrails are written in code and tested.
items: Consent to access: 18 or older and the terms, on the first sign-in
A deterministic crisis cut-off, before the model: a fixed text naming 9-8-8 and 811 (Info-Social), recording nothing
A neighbour that gives no advice: what is outside a chat is declined
Access by invitation, closed to minors
No conversation kept: no transcript, no summary
Limits on length, exchanges and chats per day, applied by the server

own.title: What Yororis adds
items: Limits applied by the server, not by the screen
Everything is wiped at the end of the chat
No mood measure, nothing inferred, no score
Deletion of the account by the person, at once
Access by invitation, checked by CI: no way to create an account

open.title: Read it, check it
open.lead: Everything above is written in public.

study.lead: Questions, not conclusions, answered with a lawyer before anything is offered to the public.
items: Québec: Law 25 (personal information), the Charter of the French language and the company's legal notices
Canada: federal privacy law and what may be said to organisations
France and the European Union: the AI Act (telling people they talk to an AI) and GDPR
Belgium: the same European questions, and the crisis lines of both language communities
Everywhere: the conditions of a test with outside people, and insurance

stops.title: A neighbour who has to go
stops.lead: The limits are not a technical constraint: they are the product. Applied by the server, shown on screen.

decisions.chose: A short break: 8 minutes, 8 exchanges, 2 chats a day
decisions.refused: A neighbour available at any hour
decisions.because: A neighbour who never leaves ends up taking all the room. The chat ends, and you go back to your life and your people.
decisions.cost: Some evenings you will want more and won't get it. “The neighbour has to go.”

decisions.chose: An AI that says so every chat, with a permanent “AI” mark
decisions.refused: A face that could pass for a person
decisions.because: Presence comes from rhythm and attention, not from fooling anyone. Europe's AI Act asks for it; honesty asks for it everywhere.
decisions.cost: Less of an illusion. That is the point.

decisions.chose: Nothing is kept: no transcript, no summary, no measure of your mood
decisions.refused: Reading feelings from your voice or your words
decisions.because: No model decides how you feel, and nothing is computed about you. It is more honest, and it is the best protection of your information.
decisions.cost: No history of your evenings, only what you remember.

decisions.chose: No nudge to return, no counter, no extra chat for sale
decisions.because: A neighbour who wants you back is not a neighbour.
decisions.cost: Growth we will have to earn another way, without capturing attention.

privacy.title: What is held, for how long, who reads it
privacy.lead: Short answers, under Québec's Law 25: the strict minimum.

items.a: Your e-mail, your first name, your language, your picture and the date you agreed, only to let you in. Nothing of what you say.
As long as you keep your account. You can delete it at once, and everything about you goes with it.
Nobody: what you say is neither recorded nor transcribed, and the team sees only counters without text.

cta.title: Write to us
cta.body: An organisation that wants to talk, a person who wants to read the framework, a developer who wants to build it with us: write to us. While we test, that is the one open door.

features.title: Someone who is there, without crowding you

items.title: It says what it is
items.text: An AI, with a first name and a permanent “AI” mark. It never passes for a person.

items.title: Light, sometimes funny
items.text: An anecdote, a gentle joke, another angle when you go in circles. Never advice.

items.title: A few minutes
items.text: A short break: a few exchanges, the time left always on screen. Then the neighbour has to go.

items.title: Nothing is kept
items.text: What you say is gone at the end. No transcript, no summary, no history.
